## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed?

## Proposed Solution

Describe your proposed solution. Be as detailed as possible.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe alternative solutions you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add any mockups, diagrams, examples, or additional context here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues and features
- [ ] This aligns with Udaya's goals and architecture
- [ ] I have described the problem and solution clearly
- [ ] This is not a bug report (use bug_report template instead)
